estimates.assumptions: 4 cm piece of fresh ginger ≈ 12 g based on typical finger thickness; matches supplied knownCaloriesPer100g for raw ginger.
50 preserved vine leaves at ~3 g each (standard drained weight for medium 10-12 cm pickled grape leaves); ~35 kcal/100 g is typical for brined vine leaves in their prepared state.
1 large fennel bulb (edible trimmed portion) ≈ 350 g; matches supplied knownCaloriesPer100g for raw fennel.
1 medium onion (edible portion) ≈ 110 g; matches supplied knownCaloriesPer100g for raw onion.
1 small peeled potato ≈ 80 g after peeling/grating; matches supplied knownCaloriesPer100g for raw potato.
2 tbsp uncooked basmati rice ≈ 25 g (standard density); matches supplied knownCaloriesPer100g for dry rice.
½ tsp ground cloves ≈ 1.2 g (standard spice density); matches supplied knownCaloriesPer100g.
½ tsp ground cinnamon ≈ 1.3 g (standard spice density); matches supplied knownCaloriesPer100g.
2 medium tomatoes (edible raw) ≈ 240 g total; matches supplied knownCaloriesPer100g for raw tomato.
